result.rationale: Vineyard Offshore is the CIP platform; Vineyard Northeast is OCS-A 0522, and Vineyard Wind 2 is a project inside that lease. Separate company records double-count CIP.

identityResolution.legalChain: Vineyard Wind LLC → OCS-A 0522 LLC → Vineyard Northeast LLC
identityResolution.boundary: Keep Vineyard Northeast as lease/project identity, Vineyard Northeast LLC as SPV, and Vineyard Wind 2 as a 1.2-GW project within OCS-A 0522—not as a successor company.

ownershipResolution.finding: CIP/CI IV owns 100% of OCS-A 0522. Avangrid has no current interest there; its continuing 50% interest is only Vineyard Wind 1. Vineyard Offshore is developer/affiliate, not the lease transferee.

operatingResolution.geography: OCS-A 0522; 132,370 federal-water acres about 29-31 miles from Nantucket.
operatingResolution.capacity: Up to 160 positions; Vineyard Wind 2 up to 1.2 GW, with additional lease-area development possible.
operatingResolution.stage: Pre-construction; no verified financing close, FID or construction decision.
operatingResolution.markets: New England and potentially New York via Massachusetts and Connecticut corridors.
operatingResolution.status: BOEM lease active to Vineyard Northeast LLC; project/permitting paused or shelved, with FAST-41 paused to 2027-04-01. No legal cancellation or surrender was found.

acquisitionExitCheck.auction: The 50/50 Avangrid/CIP Vineyard Wind LLC JV won the December 2018 auction; lease effective 2019-04-01.
acquisitionExitCheck.restructuring: Announced 2021-09-21; closed 2022-01-10. CIP/CI IV acquired OCS-A 0522 LLC and 100% of lease rights; Avangrid exited.
acquisitionExitCheck.procurement: Massachusetts provisionally selected 800 MW in September 2024; Vineyard Offshore withdrew on 2024-12-20 after Connecticut selected no offshore wind. No PPA or ownership closing resulted.
acquisitionExitCheck.laterCheck: No later sale, partner, financing close, FID, construction commitment, lease surrender or ownership transfer was verified.

milestones.event: OCS-A 0522 lease became effective to Vineyard Wind LLC.
CIP/CI IV acquired OCS-A 0522 LLC and 100% of lease rights; Avangrid exited.
Massachusetts selected 800 MW of Vineyard Wind 2; Vineyard Offshore later withdrew the bid.
FAST-41 extension left permitting paused to 2027-04-01; lease remained active.

beforeAfterChanges.after: Merge under Vineyard Offshore; keep 2019 as lease/JV history and 2022-01-10 as CIP full-control entry, with SPV/project below the platform.

unresolvedQuestions: Exact rename date from OCS-A 0522 LLC to Vineyard Northeast LLC and the current intermediate holding chain are not public; neither affects the conclusions.

recommendedListAction.result: One CIP manager-level company; no current Avangrid ownership.
